clue.text: Writer, speaking no German, gets to a measurable distance of the hills

parts.note: a pen is the writing instrument, a classic crossword writer

indicators.note: speaking says the German word is to be taken as it sounds when said

parts.note: the German for no is nein
a chain is an old unit of length, 22 yards

explanation.surface: An author who refuses to speak German walks a set distance into the hills.
explanation.walkthrough: 'speaking' turns NEIN (German for no) into the sound NINE. The Pennine Chain is the range of hills running down northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pennines are a long range of English uplands, so a chain of hills.

clue.text: Shortage appearing in a French capital town

parts.note: Pau is the capital of the Pyrenees-Atlantiques department in south-west France
a city is a large town

explanation.surface: A scarcity of something turns up in the capital of France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a French capital' suggests Paris, but it is the departmental capital PAU.
explanation.definitionFit: Paucity means a scarcity or too small a quantity of something.

clue.text: Silly seabirds

definitions.meaning: a noddy is a simpleton, so silly people
the noddy is a tropical tern

explanation.surface: Some seabirds behaving foolishly.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a fool and a dark tropical tern go by the same old name, noddy.

clue.text: Angry din in gnat-swarm

indicators.note: a swarm of gnats is a jumbled mass, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Someone is enraged by the noise of a buzzing cloud of gnats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swarm' shuffles DIN, IN and GNAT together; 'in' looks like a link but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Indignant means resentful at unfair treatment, a kind of anger.

clue.text: Where the north wall is a place for climbers not ramblers

definitions.text: Where the north wall is a place for climbers not ramblers

parts.words: Where the north wall is a place for climbers not ramblers
parts.note: describes a Swiss Alpine peak whose sheer north face is famous among mountaineers and no walk for hikers

explanation.surface: A wall facing north is for climbing plants rather than rambling roses.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads like gardening advice about climbing and rambling plants; the climbers are mountaineers and the north wall is the famous Nordwand.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eiger in the Bernese Alps has a notorious north face scaled only by expert mountaineers.

clue.text: Fowl pest? Poisoning anyway

parts.note: a hen is a domestic fowl
a bane is a curse or pest

explanation.surface: Something that plagues chickens turns out to be poisonous anyway.
explanation.walkthrough: Henbane is a poisonous plant; 'anyway' marks the definition as loose, since it poisons rather than being a poisoning.
explanation.definitionFit: Henbane is a toxic nightshade plant used historically as a poison.

clue.text: Analyse Times, i.e., make a list of articles

indicators.note: to analyse is to break something down, so these letters are taken apart and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Break down the newspaper, that is, list its articles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Analyse' rearranges TIMES and IE (from 'i.e.'); the newspaper's 'articles' are really items.
explanation.definitionFit: To itemise is to set out a list of separate items one by one.

clue.text: Parish postman who draws well when properly lit up

definitions.meaning: a holder of a post in a parish, a lay officer of the church

definitions.text: who draws well when properly lit up
definitions.meaning: a long-stemmed clay tobacco pipe, which draws smoke once lit

explanation.surface: A village postman who is good at drawing once he has had a few drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'postman' is a post-holder, not a letter carrier, and 'lit up' is a pipe being lit, not a drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a lay parish officer and a long clay smoking pipe.

clue.text: Pursued doggedly

parts.note: chased relentlessly, as if by a pack of hunting dogs

explanation.definitionFit: To be harried persistently is to be chased as hunting dogs chase a quarry.

clue.text: Associates of the R.A.

parts.note: R.A. reads as the Royal Academy of artists but is the Royal Artillery, whose soldiers fire the big guns

explanation.surface: Associate members of the Royal Academy of Arts.
explanation.walkthrough: An Associate of the Royal Academy (ARA) is a painter, but R.A. here is the Royal Artillery.
explanation.definitionFit: Artillery soldiers serve in the Royal Artillery, the British army's cannon regiment.

clue.text: Salad days? The year of the pudding, rather

definitions.meaning: salad days are youthful, inexperienced years; the question mark marks one example of them

definitions.text: The year of the pudding, rather
definitions.meaning: a pudding is a sweet in Britain, so the year of age named after one

explanation.surface: Were these the days of salad, or rather the year of dessert?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Salad days' (from Shakespeare) means callow youth; a sweet is the British word for a pudding course, giving a sixteenth birthday read as a dessert year.
explanation.definitionFit: Turning sixteen is a celebrated milestone of youth, the heart of one's carefree teenage years.

clue.text: Abuse used by fencers?

definitions.meaning: fence-builders use rails; swordsmen are the false reading

explanation.surface: Insults hurled by fencing swordsmen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fencers' suggests sword fighters, but it means people putting up fences.
explanation.definitionFit: Railing at someone is bitter scolding; a railing is also a barrier made of rails.

clue.text: Make money out of property

parts.note: turning assets such as land into cash by selling them

explanation.surface: Earn a living from real estate.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a landlord earning rent; the sense is converting assets into cash.
explanation.definitionFit: To convert an asset into cash by selling it is a financial sense of this verb.

clue.text: Hindhead votes for this place

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter, here taken from the word before it

parts.note: ayes are votes in favour

explanation.surface: The people of Hindhead, a Surrey village, vote in favour of this place.
explanation.walkthrough: Hindhead is a real Surrey village, but split it: 'Hind head' gives H. Hayes is a town in west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Hayes is a town in the London borough of Hillingdon, so a place.

clue.text: On which gentlemen don't go a-courting, it's under, stood

definitions.text: On which gentlemen don't go a-courting, it's under, stood

parts.words: On which gentlemen don't go a-courting, it's under, stood
parts.note: a gentlemen's pact is not enforced in a law court, being simply understood between the parties

explanation.surface: Gentlemen do not go wooing; it is all tacitly understood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a-courting' sounds like romance but means going to a court of law: a gentleman's deal is unwritten and never litigated.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentlemen's pact is an informal understanding resting on honour rather than law.

clue.text: Official entertainment upset by interference

definitions.meaning: a formal party held to welcome guests
radio or television signal quality, spoilt by electrical interference

explanation.surface: A formal function is disrupted by meddling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interference' reads as meddling but is the radio sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a formal welcoming party and the quality of a broadcast signal.

clue.text: Arm shooting out without human control?

definitions.meaning: a self-loading firearm that keeps shooting

explanation.surface: A limb flails out on its own.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arm' is a weapon, not a limb.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-loading gun and a self-operating machine share this adjective-noun.

clue.text: Inland port comparable to Troon ?

indicators.note: comparable means made of the same stuff, so the letters are a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A port far from the sea is likened to the Scottish golfing town of Troon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comparable' asks for TO and TROON to be rearranged. Troon is a seaside town in Ayrshire, Scotland. Toronto is on a lake, far inland.
explanation.definitionFit: Toronto stands on Lake Ontario and handles shipping via the St Lawrence Seaway, though far from the ocean.

clue.text: Most likely to succeed, where earth is the inheritance

definitions.text: Most likely to succeed, where earth is the inheritance

parts.words: Most likely to succeed, where earth is the inheritance
parts.note: alludes to the Beatitude saying the humble shall inherit the earth, so the humblest would succeed to it

explanation.surface: The likeliest heir is the one who inherits land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'succeed' means succeed to an inheritance, as in the Sermon on the Mount: 'Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.'
explanation.definitionFit: The most humble and submissive people are the heirs of the earth in the Beatitudes.

clue.text: The beginning of a tropic island

indicators.note: only the opening part of the tropic's name is kept, the end dropped

parts.note: the Tropic of Capricorn is one of the two tropics

explanation.surface: Where a tropical island begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The beginning of' keeps CAPRI from CAPRICORN, the southern tropic, dropping CORN.
explanation.definitionFit: Capri is an island in the Bay of Naples.

clue.text: Preserve crushed peas for small savouries

parts.note: to can food is to preserve it in tins

indicators.note: crushed peas are broken up, so their letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Tin some mashed peas to serve as snacks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crushed' rearranges PEAS into APES after CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Canapes are small savoury snacks served on bread or pastry.

clue.text: Ecclesiastic variety of eel trap

indicators.note: a variety is a different form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A churchman picks a type of eel-catching basket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variety of' shuffles EEL and TRAP.
explanation.definitionFit: A prelate is a high-ranking churchman such as a bishop.

clue.text: The German went to the river

parts.note: der is a German word for the

explanation.surface: The German man made his way to the river.
explanation.walkthrough: The Derwent is a river name found in several English counties.
explanation.definitionFit: The Derwent is an English waterway, flowing through Derbyshire among others.

clue.text: Friendly Indian conveyance

definitions.meaning: Captain Cook named this archipelago the Friendly Islands
a light two-wheeled horse-drawn cart used in India

explanation.surface: A sociable means of transport in India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Friendly' is the old name of the Pacific island kingdom.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonga is both the Friendly Islands kingdom and a small Indian horse carriage.

clue.text: Caustic description of brass-hat in punt!

indicators.note: the officer is placed inside the boat

parts.note: a brass hat is a senior officer, a general, shortened to GEN

explanation.surface: A biting remark about a top army officer sitting in a punt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts GEN, short for general, inside PUNT.
explanation.definitionFit: Pungent remarks are sharp and biting, like caustic ones.

clue.text: Cotton cloth makes little Ann wail

parts.note: Nan is a pet form of the name Ann
to keen is to wail in mourning

explanation.surface: A piece of cotton makes a small girl cry.
explanation.walkthrough: To keen is an Irish-derived word for lamenting aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: Nankeen is a yellowish cotton fabric first made in Nanjing.

clue.text: Instead of a fashionable spot ?

explanation.surface: Instead of a trendy venue.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense needs 'of' to complete the phrase, which the clue supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means substitute for, and also a trendy venue where 'in' means fashionable.

clue.text: The height of inspiration in Paris

definitions.text: The height of inspiration in Paris

parts.words: The height of inspiration in Paris
parts.note: the mountain of the Muses, in its French form, which is also a Paris district

explanation.surface: The peak of creativity is to be found in the French capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Mount Parnassus was home to the Muses, so 'the height of inspiration'; the Left Bank district bears its French name.
explanation.definitionFit: A Paris quarter of artists named after the Greek mountain sacred to Apollo and the Muses.
